_comment: Street generation ruleset. Value-identical to ExpansionRuleTable.Defaults(); if
this file is absent the generator falls back to those defaults and produces the
ORDER MATTERS TWICE OVER, and not in the same way:
- 'rules' is the order in which each rule's probability is drawn. Reordering the
array reorders the random sequence and changes every generated cluster.
- weights and emission run per weight group, and within a group in the order the
rules appear here. So the default table draws forward/right/left/random but
emits straight(forward, randStroke) then branch(right, left).
Exactly one rule must be marked isFallback; it fires when nothing else does, so a
probability.kind is one of constant (a), affine (a - w*b) or hyperbola
(a / (1 + b*(1-w))), where w is the parent weight normalised over weightMin..Max.
Anything else is refused when this file is parsed.
